cases.claim: If Mara's encounter with Eli is intended as literal supernatural content in a China distribution version, consider presenting it as a dream to address the cited restriction; regulator acceptance remains uncertain.

support_spans.quote: Under China's censorship laws any films suggesting the existence of the supernatural can be banned from distribution. script_spans:
ELI VOSS (70) is sitting in front of the far glass. Work jacket. Salt-white stubble. He was not there a moment ago, and the room does not find this strange.

ELI
You put the Hopper crooked.

Mara does not turn around. Her hands go still on the register.

ELI (CONT'D)
It's been crooked eleven years. But you looked at it tonight, so now it's your fault.

MARA
(not turning)
You're not here.

ELI
I'm not anywhere. It's very freeing. No tide chart. No Coors Light.
